## 简体中文

### 新增

- 在系统 Dock 控件旁新增“退出”操作，并提供居中的确认对话框。

### 修复

- 在任务栏应用之间移动时复用同一个动画窗口预览面板，避免预览重叠，同时平滑调整位置与尺寸。
- WinTaskbar 隐藏系统 Dock 后，退出应用时恢复 Dock。

## English

### Added

- Added an Exit action beside the system Dock control with a centered confirmation dialog.

### Fixed

- Reused one animated window preview panel when moving between taskbar apps, preventing overlapping previews while smoothly adapting its position and size.
- Restored the system Dock when WinTaskbar exits after hiding it.
